LESSON: SIDES OF BY THE END OF THE SUB- MEASUREMENT BE ABLE TO:

Grade: PP2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.1: Sides of By the end of the sub- MEASUREMENT be able to:

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Sides of By the end of the sub- MEASUREMENT be able to:. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify different sides of objects in the environment
2. manipulate objects of different sides in the environment
3. enjoy measuring sides of objects using arbitrary units

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify different sides of objects in the environment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify different sides of objects in the environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. manipulate objects of different sides in the environment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to manipulate objects of different sides in the environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. enjoy measuring sides of objects using arbitrary units
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to enjoy measuring sides of objects using arbitrary units. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market in your county, count 10 mangoes. Put them in 2 groups of 5. That is sorting and grouping.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row. Write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and your parent gives you 5 more, you have 12 shillings. That is addition.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Sides of By the end of the sub- MEASUREMENT be able to:.
2. Explain Sides of By the end of the sub- MEASUREMENT be able to: to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sides of By the end of the sub- MEASUREMENT be able to:.
4. Show that you can: identify different sides of objects in the environment
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Sides of By the end of the sub- MEASUREMENT be able to:. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Sides of By the end of the sub- MEASUREMENT be able to: important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify different sides of objects in the environment
2. manipulate objects of different sides in the environment
3. enjoy measuring sides of objects using arbitrary units

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
